build_mesh_from_sparse_tensor: build a mesh from a SparseTensor by calling SparseFeatures2Mesh with cube features and resolution
create_mesh_extract_result: create a MeshExtractResult object from vertices and faces tensors to compute face normals
compute_face_normals: compute normalized face normals from vertex positions and face indices using MeshExtractResult.comput_face_normals
compute_vertex_normals: compute normalized vertex normals by averaging adjacent face normals using MeshExtractResult.comput_v_normals
extract_feature_layout: extract a named feature layout slice from a tensor using SparseFeatures2Mesh.get_layout with sdf, deform, color, or weights
